Services

A comprehensive range of financial services.

With accounting, bookkeeping, taxation, consulting, and financial planning, Kaadi Financial is here to guide clients every step of the way.

Bookkeeping & Accounting

Monthly reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, payroll processing, expense tracking, and financial statements.

Taxation

Corporate and personal tax preparation, strategic tax planning, audit/dispute support, and GST/HST or sales tax filings.

Consulting

Business strategy, forecasting, budgeting, cash flow management, risk assessment, and growth or expansion planning.

Financial Planning

Retirement planning, savings optimization, investment analysis, insurance and risk planning, estate and succession planning.
